source.text: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ወርኢኩ፡ በህየ፡ አራዊተ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ወ*ይትዌለጥ፡ ፩እምካልኡ፡ ወአዕዋፍሂ፡ ይትዌለጥ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ወ⟦?⟧፡ ወቃሎሙሂ፡ ይትዌለጥ፡ ፩እምካልኡ።
source.note: Middle bird descriptor remains uncertified and is represented by a modern unknown marker, not a printed ancient gap. Whole unit held; no plumage/beauty/tooth substitution adopted.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Current provisional formወስኖሙ not certified here as exact selected fidels/lemma. The actual photo and distinct garment/beauty/tooth lexical leads do not justify silent normalization. Modern marker is not an ancient gap.

translation.text: From there I went as far as the ends of the earth, and there I saw large beasts that differed from one another. The birds also differed in their appearance and ⟦unresolved descriptor⟧, and their voices also differed from one another.[a]

footnotes.text: This whole unit remains held. The middle bird descriptor has not passed this review’s exact-fidel and lexical checks. Garment/plumage, beauty/form and tooth entries are distinct primary lexical leads; none is silently substituted merely to fit familiar descriptions of birds. The modern unresolved marker records this reader’s limit, not an ancient lacuna. Appearance and voices, large beasts, the difference predicates and one-from-another expressions are retained, but this draft is not approved for publication.

source.text: ወ*ጽባሖሙ፡ ለ*እሉ፡ አርዌ፡ ርኢኩ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ በኀበ፡ ሰማይ፡ የዐርፍ፡ ወኀዋኅወ፡ ሰማይ፡ ርኁዋተ።
source.note: Selected east/beasts and heaven-rest relation retained with the attested intransitive derived lexical range; no modern support model or geographic identification supplied.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Actual primary970 derived entry attests intransitive rest/settle as well as transitive ranges; English does not infer a modern physical edge/support model.

translation.text: To the east of these beasts I saw the ends of the earth, where heaven comes to rest, and the open gates of heaven.[a]

footnotes.text: East follows the selected morning/east expression, not a substituted beyond-these relation. The selected heaven-rest construction is rendered with the intransitive rest/settle range actually attested in the primary Dillmann1865 derived entry at column970; this does not assert that every derived form is intransitive. It retains the visionary wording without certifying a physical support model, a modern geographic edge, or a named location. The open gate/opening expression is checked against the primary column606 range.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ እፎ፡ ይወጽኡ፡ ከዋክብተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኍልቁ፡ ዘእምነ፡ ይወፅኡ፡ ኀዋኅወ፡ ወጸሐፍኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሙፃኣቲሆሙ፡ ለለ*፩፩፡ በኍልቆሙ፡ ወእስማቲሆሙ፡ በደርጎሙ፡ ወምገባሮሙ፡ ወጊዜሆሙ፡ ወአውራኂሆሙ፡ በከመ፡ አርአየኒ፡ ኡርኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ዘምስሌየ፡ ቅዱስ።
source.note: Actual how word and gate-count clause restored. Quantity noun and real star distinguished from raised apparatus references. Full list and selected short angel-name form retained.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Corrects currentአፎ andኍለቁ; removes nonprinted star arising by raised31. Real doubled-one star remains; no fixed calculated star total supplied.

translation.text: I saw how the stars of heaven come out, and the number of the gates from which they come out. I wrote down all their goings out, one by one, according to their number and names, their ranks, activity, times and months, as Urel, the holy angel who was with me, showed me.[a]

footnotes.text: The actual opening word is እፎ, how (primary Dillmann1865 columns806–807), not a mouth noun used to supply unprinted portals at this point. Gates are explicitly present in the following count clause, which is retained in full. The actual quantity noun is transcribed ኍልቁ, and raised apparatus number31 near the later quantity phrase is not a critical star; the real star before the doubled one numeral is retained. All items in the selected list remain, including ranks, activity, times and months; no year, season, modern star catalogue or calculation is added. Urel follows selected ኡርኤል rather than silently adding a syllable or a different angel classification. Goings out and the ordered list are literal visionary terms, not a modern astronomical certification.

source.text: ኵሎ፡ አርአየኒ፡ ወጸሐፈ፡ ሊተ፡ ወዓዲ፡ አስማቲሆሙ፡ *ጸሐፈ፡ ሊተ፡ ወትእዛዞሙ፡ ወ*ማኅበራቲሆሙ።
source.note: Selected third-person writing forms, repeated names, commands and assembly/grouping term retained; no modern constellation identification supplied.

translation.text: He showed me everything and wrote it down for me. Again he wrote down for me their names, their commands and their groupings.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected writing verbs are third-person he-wrote forms, unlike the first-person I-wrote form in the preceding unit. Both writing clauses and the repeated names remain. Commands can also be rendered ordinances, and groupings represents the assembly/company family (primary Dillmann1865 columns598–599). It is not an independently identified set of modern constellations or celestial conjunctions.
